issue: Article body is wider than the phone viewport, so text, the Key Takeaways box, the 'Talk to Dr. Lavi' card and the cost table are cut off mid-word at the right edge (e.g. 'survival ne…', 'high U…'). The page cannot be read on a phone.
where: Article body, Key Takeaways, sidebar CTA and tables, 375 (capture is 456px wide). Other posts with tables also render wider than 375 (bone-grafting-for-dental-implants-guide 464, dental-implants-for-seniors 461, what-is-all-on-x 462 and more)
fix: Give the article grid column min-width:0 (or minmax(0,1fr)) so long tables cannot widen it, and wrap every prose <table> in an overflow-x:auto container (or turn rows into stacked cards under 640px). Then check every blog post at 375.
status: Fixed (article column min-width 0; tables scroll inside a focusable region; clipped-overflow check added)

issue: Hero and article photos show a coat or scrubs embroidered 'Dr. Jason Verdi, Cosmetic Dentistry' / 'Jason Verdi, DDS', right beside copy that names Dr. Nuriel Lavi. Visitors who notice it may stop trusting the site.
where: Home hero (all widths), Services hero, Appointment hero, Testimonials hero, Emergency hero, blog post hero (dental-implants-cost) and several blog cards
fix: Ask the practice to confirm who is in these photos. If the embroidery is wrong or from another practice, retouch the name out or replace the photos with ones where the name matches (or is not visible).
status: Remaining: needs the practice to confirm or replace the photos

issue: The category rows leave many empty grid slots: Cosmetic has 5 cards in a 3-column grid (row 2 has 2), Restorative has 4 (one card alone), Oral Surgery has 5, and Holistic and Preventive each have one card with two thirds of the row empty. The page looks unfinished and lopsided.
where: Category sections 01-05, 1440 (also 1024-1920)
fix: Fill each row: let the cards use auto-fit columns, or merge the single-card categories (Holistic, Preventive) into one combined row. For one-card categories, use a wide horizontal card (image left, text right) across the full content width.
status: Fixed (no-orphan card grid; single cards span the row)

issue: The Google reviews carousel has only 2 reviews, shown in a 3-column track, so the right third is empty and the prev/next arrows do nothing useful. On the Testimonials page this leaves the 'Recent reviews' section looking thin.
where: Reviews section on Home, Testimonials, New Patient Offer and every service page, 1024-1920
fix: Add at least 6-9 real reviews to content/testimonials.json. Until then, show the cards in a 2-column grid without arrows (hide the controls when items <= visible slots), or use the empty third for the 4.9 rating summary card.
status: Fixed (2–3 reviews show as a grid without dead arrows; more real reviews needed for the carousel)

issue: The insurance logo strip has wildly different sizes: MetLife and Cigna are tiny and unreadable, while Aetna and Humana are about 3x heavier. The Blue Cross Blue Shield logo is cropped ('BlueC / BlueS'). On mobile the logos wrap into a ragged pile.
where: 'Most major PPO plans accepted' band on Services, Contact, Appointment and others, all widths (worst at 375)
fix: Re-export the logos with consistent padding and give each logo a fixed box (e.g. h-8, max-w-[120px], object-contain) so they share one visual weight. Replace the clipped BCBS asset with the full logo. On mobile use a 2- or 3-column grid with equal cells.
status: Fixed (padding trimmed, equal cells sized by shape); Blue Cross shows its marks until a complete file is supplied

issue: The hero photo crops off the top of Dr. Lavi's head, and the headline and intro sit over his face and chin. On mobile, the eyebrow, H1 and body copy run straight across his face.
where: Page hero, 1440 and 375
fix: Move the image focal point (object-position: 70% 20% on desktop; position the face above the text block on mobile), or use a photo with empty space on the text side. Alternatively use the split hero layout from the home page, with the text and photo side by side.
status: Fixed (focal point; phones show the photo above the text)

issue: Card images are poorly cropped on mobile. In the TMJ card, the dentist's and patient's heads sit on the bottom edge with chins cut off, and most of the frame is ceiling and window. In the Holistic card, the patient's reflection is cut off at the bottom.
where: 'Holistic care and jaw pain relief' cards, 375 (also 414)
fix: Set object-position per image (e.g. 'center 75%' for the TMJ photo), or use a taller aspect ratio (4/3) for these card images on mobile so the faces stay in frame.
status: Fixed (focal point on the card photos)

issue: The article hero image shows a chair back and the dentist's torso with his head cropped out. It is the weakest possible crop for a lead image, and on mobile it shrinks to a ~145px strip with no person visible.
where: Article lead image, 1440 and 375
fix: Use a different photo or set object-position toward the top/right so the face is in frame. On mobile use a taller ratio (16/10 or 4/3) instead of the very wide strip.
status: Fixed (taller crop on phones, focal point higher)

issue: On mobile, readers must scroll past the full 'In this article' list and the dark 'Talk to Dr. Lavi' CTA (~700px) before reaching the Key Takeaways or the first paragraph.
where: Article top, 375
fix: Below lg, put the Key Takeaways and article first. Collapse the TOC into a <details> 'In this article' toggle, and move the CTA card to after the intro or the end of the article.
status: Fixed (article first on phones; contents list and booking card follow)

issue: The Related treatments row has 3 cards in a 4-column grid, leaving an empty quarter at the right edge.
where: 'Related treatments', 1440 (same component on other service pages)
fix: Size the grid to the number of items (grid-cols-3 when there are 3), or always supply 4 related treatments.
status: Fixed (grid sized to the number of items)

issue: 'Everything under one roof' uses 2 half-width cards, then 1 half-width card with an empty slot beside it, then 1 full-width card. The grid looks broken.
where: 'Comprehensive services' cards, 1440
fix: Use a consistent 2x2 grid (make Restorative & surgical half width) or a 4-column row. Avoid mixing a lone half card with a full-width card.
status: Fixed (only an odd last card spans the row)

issue: Button sizes are inconsistent. The about-page service cards use small ~36px 'Book now' buttons with ~13px text, while elsewhere primary buttons are 46-52px with 15-16px text. The primary CTA is green on the home hero but white on every other dark/photo hero.
where: About 'Everything under one roof' cards vs. heroes and CTA bands, 1440
fix: Define two button sizes (default 48px, compact 40px) in one Button component and use them everywhere. Choose one primary treatment for dark backgrounds (white or brand green) and apply it to all heroes.
status: Fixed (one button system; same primary button on every hero; standard sizes in About cards)

issue: 'What to do right now' is the most urgent content on the page, but it has the weakest hierarchy: plain paragraphs, no eyebrow, no container. Its narrow column starts at about x=300, matching neither the left-aligned sections nor the centred headers around it.
where: 'What to do right now', 1440
fix: Show it as a highlighted card or numbered checklist (icon + bold situation + action) aligned to the main content grid, with an eyebrow like the other sections. Put the 'go to the ER' line in a visually distinct alert row.
status: Improved (checklist shown as a card aligned to the content grid)

issue: Heading case is mixed, even within one page. Service pages use Title Case ('What Are Dental Implants?', 'Pre- And Post-Care For Dental Implants', 'Why Choose Valencia Dentistry For Dental Implants?') next to sentence case ('Questions patients ask about dental implants'), and the rest of the site is sentence case.
where: Service detail pages (e.g. Dental Implants body), all widths
fix: Convert the service-page H2/H3 copy to sentence case to match the home, about and blog pages (fix 'Pre- And Post-Care For' etc. in the service content source).
status: Not changed: Title Case H2s are the practice’s original SEO copy, kept as instructed

issue: In the technology grid cards, 'What this means for you' sits at different heights in the same row (Digital X-rays, iTero, PRF, Guided implant surgery), and every card has a large empty band below it. The section looks unfinished until hovered.
where: 'The equipment, and what it means for you' (home) and 'Technology in the office, explained' (about), 1024-1920
fix: Make each card a flex column and pin the 'What this means for you' row with mt-auto (or a fixed-height description area). Reserve only the reveal height actually needed, or show the answer by default on desktop.
status: Fixed (subgrid rows)

issue: In 'What happens at your first visit', the left column (eyebrow, H2, $59 card) is vertically centred against the tall timeline, leaving ~350px of blank space above the heading. The same block on /appointment/ is top-aligned. 'Our story' on About has the same blank space above its text, centred beside a tall photo.
where: First-visit section 1440 (home); 'Our story' 1440 (about)
fix: Top-align (items-start) the text column, optionally with lg:sticky lg:top-28 so it follows the timeline. Do the same for the About 'Our story' text.
status: Not changed: the timeline column is already sticky and top-aligned; the About photo/text centring is intended

issue: Paired CTAs that stack on mobile get different widths (e.g. 'Book your $59 exam' 208px over a 152px phone button, 'Book a visit' over 'See our services', 'Get directions' over 'Book an appointment'), so the left-aligned stack has a ragged right edge.
where: Hero and section CTA pairs on Home, About, Contact and service pages, 375-414
fix: Below sm, make stacked button groups full width (w-full, or flex-col with items-stretch), or keep pairs side by side in equal 1fr columns.
status: Fixed for hero button groups (full-width stack on phones)

issue: In the 'Visit us' hours list the values column does not line up: '8am – 5pm' starts about 27px left of 'Closed', because each value sits right after its label instead of in a shared column.
where: 'Visit us' block on Home, About, Contact, Appointment, New Patient Offer, Emergency, all widths
fix: Render hours as a 2-column grid (grid-cols-[auto_1fr] gap-x-6) or a <dl>/<table> so the times line up.
status: Fixed (hours in a two-column grid)

issue: The article page has three different left edges: the title block starts at ~243px, the lead image and TOC sidebar at ~166px, and the article body at ~452px. The header does not line up with the content below it.
where: Article header vs. image vs. body, 1440
fix: Put the header in the same container and 2-column grid as the body (title over the body column, or the whole header aligned to the image edge) so all three share one edge.
status: Fixed (header aligned with the article grid)

issue: Cost and comparison tables are cramped even on desktop: price cells wrap to three or four lines ('$3,000 to / $6,000 per / tooth') while other columns have spare room.
where: 'Longevity versus upfront price' and 'Implants versus other replacement options' tables, 1440
fix: Set white-space:nowrap on price ranges (or write them as '$3,000–$6,000 / tooth'), give the first column a min-width, and use tabular-nums for figures.
status: Improved (first column min-width, tabular figures, tables scroll on phones)

issue: The left column ('Prefer to talk it through?' + details list) ends about halfway down the much taller form card, leaving a large empty block beside it. The same office details then repeat in the 'Visit us' section below.
where: Contact intro + form, 1440 (same pattern on /appointment/ and /new-patient-offer/)
fix: Make the left column sticky (lg:sticky lg:top-28) or fill it with something useful (e.g. FAQ teaser or the map). Drop the duplicate address/hours from one of the two blocks.
status: Fixed (side column sticky beside the form)

issue: The same photos repeat in adjacent blog cards (e.g. the dentist holding the implant model appears in 'Who Is a Candidate' and directly below in 'Dental Implants With Bone Loss'; the X-ray-screen photo recurs), so the grid looks repetitive.
where: Article grid, 1440
fix: Assign distinct images per post (or at least make sure no two neighbouring cards share one). Consider category-specific illustration fallbacks when no unique photo exists.
status: Remaining: content needs more distinct blog images

issue: The office map container is an empty grey box in every capture: no map image, pin or 'Get directions' card. This is probably caused by loading=lazy plus the reveal animation not firing in a full-page capture, but on slow connections users would see the same blank panel.
where: 'Visit us' map on Home, About, Contact, Appointment, New Patient Offer, Emergency, all widths
fix: Check it in a real scroll. Use loading=eager (or fetchpriority low) for the small static map, and keep the address card visible without waiting on the reveal animation so the panel is never empty.
status: Fixed (static map with pin and directions card; live map on request)
